objective: Generate the admitted six-channel local cave anatomy from graph/context tokens without target geometry at inference, comparing a non-neural conditional baseline against a contextual probabilistic transformer.

cw3_baseline.weighting: inverse Euclidean context distance with 1e-4 floor

cw4_model.distribution: independent Gaussian in standardized log-extent space with contextual mean and scale

training.loss: confidence-weighted Gaussian negative log likelihood in standardized log-extent space
training.input_standardization: training folds only with 0.05 scale floor
training.target_standardization: training folds only with 0.05 scale floor
training.padding: masked to batch maximum token count
training.source_sampling: equal patches per available training cave each step

compiled_field: four registered zero-threshold morphology Wasserstein distances
generation: mean pairwise changed-void fraction across three frozen sampling seeds

gates.cw3_valid: all outputs target-free, finite, route-safe, and compiled for all five folds
gates.cw4_attribute: CW4 mean prediction improves confidence-weighted log-extent MAE over CW3 on at least 3 of 5 folds
gates.cw4_morphology: CW4 beats CW3 by the registered three-of-four and negative-mean-log rule on at least 3 of 5 folds
gates.cw4_shape: mean equal-volume shape IoU is no more than 0.02 below CW3
gates.cw4_volume: absolute log median volume-ratio error improves on at least 3 of 5 folds
gates.cw4_safety: all mean and sampled outputs finite with protected-route survival exactly 1.0
gates.cw4_diversity: mean pairwise changed-void fraction across frozen seeds is at least 0.005 and no more than 0.35

decision_policy.pass: admit CW4 developmental anatomy generator and begin expanded independent-cave acquisition before CW5 topology learning
decision_policy.attribute_pass_field_fail: retain transformer as attribute predictor research but reject compiled generator pending structured loss or decoder calibration
decision_policy.all_fail: retain CW3 conditional baseline and stop neural anatomy scaling until independent data expansion

claim_limit: developmental five-cave mechanism test; no population realism or production claim
